provenance.notes: Procedural, no external mesh. Southwest palette; copper eyes mark the harpoon anchors (Anchor_NN nodes).

assets.exception_why: PARK.md section 9 sets park_large at 2 draws, but each flooded-cavern recipe draws a stone shell and a water sheet (two material slots, stone and glass) and carries the -col collider mesh, which asset_registry_test counts as a draw: 3. The water sheet cannot join the stone mesh (a different slot) and the collider is the section 4 trimesh the loader needs.
